==Description==
The '''Voodoo Doll''' is a [[Flying]] enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a high amount of health and moves at the same speed as the [[Balloon Kid]]. As it is a [[Flying]] enemy, it can only be detected by towers with flying detection.

==Appearance==
The '''Voodoo Doll''' is a levitating doll made out of cardboard. It has multiple patches on its body. It has two buttons on its knees. It also has two buttons and a stitched mouth, resembling a face. There are two large pins going through its torso, one with a blue head and the other with a red head. Purple energy emanates from its body.

==Strategy==
*As it is a [[Flying]] enemy with very high health, only a limited amount of towers can deal damage to it.
**Late-game towers with flying detection, like the [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended here.
**The [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give your towers flying detection.
**The [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] can be used to boost the statistics of your towers.
*If you want to stall it, the [[Tesla]] is particularly effective with its consistent stuns and multi-target, and can chip down the enemies it spawns with.
